name: Coastlink Communications
summary: Rockingham/Kwinana ISP, began as 'Col's Point BBS' (1993); merged into Netway Technologies Jan 1997 as 'Netway Coastlink'.

events.details: Began as Col's Point BBS, Rockingham WA; ISP from Aug 1995 as Coast Link Communications; earliest coastlink.com.au capture 22 Dec 1996.
Merged into Netway Technologies (as Netway Coastlink).
